import sqlite3,pathlib,json,datetime
p=pathlib.Path('/home/appontrack/.ontrack-saas/ontrack-console.sqlite')
out={'db_exists':p.is_file(),'utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()}
if p.is_file():
 db=sqlite3.connect('file:'+str(p)+'?mode=ro',uri=True)
 db.row_factory=sqlite3.Row
 try:
  rows=db.execute("SELECT d.id,d.sim_slot,d.status,d.last_seen_at,d.agent_id,d.site_id,ag.status agent_status,ag.name agent_name FROM device_bindings d LEFT JOIN agents ag ON ag.id=d.agent_id AND ag.site_id=d.site_id AND ag.account_id=d.account_id WHERE d.id=1").fetchall()
  out['sim1_bindings']=[dict(x) for x in rows]
 except Exception as e:out['db_error']=type(e).__name__
 db.close()
trial=pathlib.Path('/home/appontrack/.ontrack-saas/tenant-voice-owner-trial.json')
if trial.is_file():
 try:
  x=json.loads(trial.read_text())
  exp=datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(x['expires_utc'].replace('Z','+00:00'))
  out['trial_enabled']=x.get('enabled') is True and exp>datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
  out['trial_expires']=x.get('expires_utc')
 except Exception:out['trial_enabled']=False
else:out['trial_present']=False
print(json.dumps(out,ensure_ascii=False))
